# Tactone

> Tactone adds UI sound effects to web apps. Wrap a React app once and every button, link, checkbox, slider, select and text field plays the right sound. 36 presets and 684 level-matched sounds, synthesized live with Web Audio. No audio files, no runtime dependencies, MIT licensed.

Install with `npm i tactone`. Works with React 18+, Next.js, TanStack Start, Vite, or no framework.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://tactone.dipxsy.app/agents.md): complete setup for coding agents, in Markdown
- [Docs](https://tactone.dipxsy.app/docs/): install, presets, rules, attributes, framework setup, custom sounds
